Name: Giant Rafflesia for PPJA Mizus Flowers
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description[/u]
[list]
[*]Adds giant crop version of [PPJA] Mizus Flowers

[/list]
[u]Quick start[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028][PPJA] Mizus Flowers[/url] and it's required mods
[*]Unzip this mod into the same folder as ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028][PPJA] Mizus Flowers[/url]
[*]If successful a "giant.png" file should have been added to "Mods\[PPJA] Mizus Flowers\[JA] Mizus Flowers\Crops\Rafflesia". This is a replacer type file, so rather than having it's own folder all this mod's files need to go into specific folders inside the other mod.
[/list]
[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]Compatible with everything [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028][PPJA] Mizus Flowers[/url] is compatible with
[/list]
[u]Recommended mods to use with this one[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11620]Giant Crop Fertilizer[/url] (Also allows you to grow giant crops anywhere)﻿
[/list]
[u]Special Thanks[/u]
